entries.name: ⌂REFIT STATIONplace rooms, corridors & gear
entries.purpose: Opens REFIT MODE — the floor editor to place rooms, run corridors, and paint decks (station refit).

entries.name: ❒RECIPESready-made missions to launch
entries.purpose: Opens the recipe (ready-made mission) library straight to the RECIPES tab so you can launch a pre-built mission.

entries.notes: Live-proven 2026-07-07T08:41:01.512Z: click→ recipe library overlay visible ('＋ SAVE A RECIPE', probe dock-door). Evidence .uiatlas/world-dock-evidence/doors-and-structure.json. onclick=openDeployBay('recipes') (app.js). Shoot state work-recipes.

entries.name: ＋RECRUITgrow the crew — summon a class, or re-spec your agen
entries.purpose: The ONE recruit door — opens the RECRUITMENT BAY to summon a new agent (class dossier) or re-spec the current one.

entries.notes: Live-proven 2026-07-07T08:41:01.512Z: click→ '.mkt-scrim' + '.mkt-dossier' RECRUITMENT BAY / CLASS DOSSIER visible (probe2 recruit-door). entries.name: ◉AGENTSeach crew member's dossier — config, memory, record

Label 'AGENTS' prefix-matches title 'AGENT DOSSIER' (label law). Covered by shoot state crew-agents + journeys J1 drive [data-term=agents].
